def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    portfolio_returns = [0.25, 0.09, 0.15]
    benchmark_returns = [0.15, 0.05, 0.18]
    benchmark_weights = [0.35, 0.35, 0.30]

    # Calculate security selection value added using benchmark weights
    security_selection = sum(
        weight * (portfolio_return - benchmark_return)
        for weight, portfolio_return, benchmark_return in zip(
            benchmark_weights, portfolio_returns, benchmark_returns
        )
    )
    answer = round(security_selection * 100, 1)

    # return answer
    return answer
